name: KUT Austin
text: Nearly 41,000 people in Travis County cast a ballot on the first day of early voting for the Nov. 3 election, surpassing every first-day voter turnout record for a midterm election this century, according to data from the Texas secretary of state’s office. https://t.co/D5rw5nUqH5 pic.twitter.com/zFSEeuLkbH
